resources.string: Core financial records are stored and processed on your device, and the AI model runs locally. Records leave the app only when you choose an action such as reporting an unrecognized SMS, exporting, backing up, or sharing.
Yes. Settings > Data Management lets you create or import a backup. You can save or share an exported backup, and PennyWise Pro can schedule daily backups to a folder you choose.

With permission, SMS scanning happens on your device to identify transaction messages. Contact access is optional and is used to replace matching UPI addresses with contact names. Reporting an unrecognized SMS sends that message, its sender, and an encrypted device identifier to the web parser only when you choose Report.
